note: Retrospective revised-source research, not prospective evidence or deployed-model accuracy. 64 library recipes are re-tuned on identical annual rolling folds; no saved fitted weights or post-test chosen settings are reused. Base fit, sigmoid calibration, inner selection and outer evaluation use disjoint chronological seasons. Original AutoML uses a bounded reproducible 4-trial standard / 6-trial deep search, not the original full search. Each selected recipe refits on base+calibration and calibrates on the former validation season before testing. GPR retains its 1,000-row recent regression window. Missing features are imputed using training data; source coverage varies. Market lines and historical weather are revised snapshots, not proven pregame observations. Paired 95% intervals use 1,000 season-week bootstrap draws, seed 42; intervals are not adjusted for 64 comparisons. No automatic promotion and no claim of future improvement. Historical source omits older ties; 2026 ties are excluded explicitly.
